lede: The Ecology Commission meets Wednesday, November 4 to discuss a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers in town by 2028 and all other combustion lawn equipment by 2030 — that's the kind of code change worth showing up for before it moves further. Also on the civic calendar, P&Z takes up a lot-line vacation at 510 W Columbia on Monday, and Norwood's Water Commission works through its 2027 draft budget the same night. Halloween weekend kicks things off with the parade, the TMHS Young Frankenstein musical, and Mountainfilm for Locals rolling into the week.

notable.stake: P&Z votes on merging two West Telluride lots into one parcel.
Draft ordinance would ban gas lawn equipment in town limits by 2028–2030.
